title: Strong enough to carry every grocery bag in one trip: the 4 moves
caption: Strength exercises for carrying groceries in one trip: Standing Hip Hinge, Doorframe Row, Air Squat and Knee Side Plank. Three rounds most days, about ten minutes, no equipment. Save this for your next grocery run.

overlays.text: Strong enough to carry every grocery bag in one trip. The 4 moves.

scenes.footer: Builds the pickup: every bag up off the ground.

overlays.text: Standing Hip Hinge. 10 reps. Soft knees, push your hips back, then stand tall.

scenes.footer: Builds grip and back: the handles stay in your hands.

overlays.text: Doorframe Row. 8 reps. Hold the frame, lean back, pull your chest to your hands.

scenes.footer: Builds the low lift: the bags off the car floor.

overlays.text: Air Squat. 10 reps. Feet hip width apart, sit your hips down, stand up tall.

scenes.footer: Builds the one-sided carry: four bags in one hand, and you stay tall.

overlays.text: Knee Side Plank. 20 seconds each side. Forearm and knee down, lift your hips, hold.

scenes.footer: You build it at home. You use it at the car.

overlays.text: This takes weeks, not days. Three rounds of the four, most days. About ten minutes.

scenes.footer: Save this for your next grocery run.

overlays.text: How many trips does it take you now?
